text: Law is a systematic system of rules that regulates social behavior and maintains fairness and justice. Its core lies in adjusting the relationships among individuals, organizations and the state through the definition of "rights and obligations". The law major not only studies legal texts (such as the Civil Code and the Criminal Law), but also explores the logic behind the rules (such as legislative purposes and judicial practices) and social values (such as fairness, order, and freedom). From contract disputes in daily life to trade disputes at the international level, from the distinction between crime and innocence in criminal cases to the risk prevention and control of enterprise compliance, the legal profession has constructed the "underlying logic of rules" of modern society and is hailed as the "engineer of social order".
